name: South Bay Galleria
summary: 3-story mall offers a range of well-known retail shops, restaurants & a light-filled center atrium.
description: South Bay Galleria is a premier shopping destination in Redondo Beach featuring 3 levels of over 140 retailers including anchor stores Macy's and Kohl's, plus an AMC Dine-In Theatre with 16 screens. The center offers a comprehensive shopping, dining, and entertainment experience with extended holiday hours and a commitment to serving the South Bay community.
demographics: South Bay Galleria serves the affluent South Bay communities of Redondo Beach, Manhattan Beach, Hermosa Beach, and Torrance, attracting middle to upper-middle-class families and professionals with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area draws from coastal residents aged 25-65, including young professionals, established families with children, and active retirees who value convenience and quality. Shoppers here exhibit preferences for a mix of value and mid-tier brands, with strong traffic during evenings and weekends for both shopping trips and entertainment-focused visits to the theater and restaurants.
